documents.zh:
MCTier 隐私政策
更新日期：2026年10月3日
适用范围：MCTier 桌面端与 Android 端；具体功能和权限因平台而异。

一、处理哪些信息
你填写的昵称、头像、大厅名称、密码及节点配置用于创建或加入大厅。应用生成本机身份、密钥及连接标识，以识别成员和建立连接。连接过程中会处理 IP 地址、虚拟 IP、在线状态、版本、连接质量和信令。公开大厅与主动投稿的节点资料会展示给其他用户，请勿填写私密信息。

二、通信与本地数据
文字、图片、语音消息、附件、文件共享和屏幕画面按功能在成员间传输。优先采用直接连接；无法直连时，可能通过所选组网或通信中继转发。服务器会处理建立连接、公共列表和版本检查所需的数据，不能把 P2P 理解为没有任何服务器参与。
应用会在设备上保存设置、聊天记录或缓存、已下载文件、运行日志和使用统计。语音转文字在本机运行内置模型。录屏按你选择的画面和声音来源采集并保存到所选目录或系统媒体库。共享或录制包含他人内容时，应先获得必要授权。

三、可选服务
夸克登录为自愿赞助功能。登录页面及请求直接与夸克服务交互，其隐私政策同时适用。MCTier 在本机加密保存账号、昵称、Cookie、过期时间和转存记录；登录成功后可通过系统后台任务每日自动转存指定分享，用于推广赞助。网络、系统调度和平台规则可能影响执行与计佣。退出夸克登录会清理凭证并停止相关任务，历史支持记录保留；网盘内已转存文件需自行管理。
点击官网、赞助链接或第三方页面后，相关网站按其规则处理访问数据。版本检查会访问更新服务；节点探测和你主动选择的自建服务会收到必要连接信息。

四、控制与保存期限
可在设置中修改资料、选择保存目录、管理消息和关闭功能，也可在系统设置撤回相应权限。撤回权限后，相关功能可能不可用，其他功能仍可继续使用。应用数据在你清理前或为相关功能所需期间保留。卸载、重置不一定删除公共媒体目录、用户选择的文件夹、导出文件及系统凭据，请按需分别清理。其他成员已收到或自行保存的副本无法由本机撤回操作保证删除。
运行日志主要用于排障。提交日志前请检查其中的节点、路径和连接信息；仅主动反馈时提供给开发者。

五、安全与联系
应用使用系统凭据存储、加密及访问校验等措施保护相关数据，但无法保证设备被入侵或接收方另行保存时的信息安全。不会将个人信息出售给第三方；提供第三方服务所必需的处理、你的明确授权及法定要求除外。未成年人应在监护人指导下使用。
可通过 https://mctier.pmhs.top 或项目仓库 https://github.com/pmh1314520/MCTier 的反馈渠道联系开发者青云制作_彭明航，提出查询、更正、删除或隐私问题；请勿在公开反馈中提交密码、Cookie 等秘密。两端设置均可离线查看本政策，修订内容以随版本发布的文本为准。
documents.en:
MCTier Privacy Policy
Updated: 3 October 2026
Scope: desktop and Android clients; features and permissions vary by platform.

1. Information processed
Your nickname, avatar, lobby name, password and node settings are used to create or join lobbies. The app generates local identities, keys and connection identifiers. Connections process IP and virtual IP addresses, presence, versions, connection quality and signaling. Public lobbies and nodes you submit are visible to other users; do not include private information.

2. Communication and local data
Text, images, voice messages, attachments, files and screen frames are exchanged between members for the relevant feature. Direct connections are preferred; selected network or communication relays may forward traffic when direct connections fail. Servers process information needed for connections, public lists and update checks. P2P does not mean that no servers are involved.
Settings, chat history or caches, downloaded files, logs and usage statistics may be stored on your device. Speech transcription uses an on-device model. Recording captures the selected screen and audio sources and saves to your chosen folder or system media library. Obtain any necessary consent before sharing or recording other people's content.

3. Optional services
Quark support is voluntary. Login pages and requests communicate directly with Quark, whose privacy terms also apply. MCTier encrypts the account, nickname, cookies, expiry and transfer history locally. After login, system background tasks can save the designated share daily to support the project through referral income. Networks, scheduling and platform rules affect execution and payment. Signing out removes credentials and stops related tasks while retaining support history; manage files already saved to the cloud separately.
Opening websites, sponsor links or third-party pages subjects those visits to their policies. Update checks contact update services; node probes and services you select receive necessary connection information.

4. Controls and retention
Edit your details, choose folders, manage messages or disable features in settings; revoke permissions through the operating system. Only related features may become unavailable. Data remains until you remove it or while needed for the feature. Uninstalling or resetting does not necessarily remove public media, chosen folders, exports or system credentials; manage those separately. Local recall cannot guarantee deletion of copies already saved by recipients.
Logs are used for troubleshooting. Review addresses, paths and connection details before voluntarily submitting them.

5. Security and contact
System credential storage, encryption and access checks protect relevant data, but cannot guarantee security on compromised devices or against recipients saving copies. Personal information is not sold. Processing needed for selected third-party services, your explicit authorization and legal requirements are exceptions to non-disclosure. Minors should use the app under guardian guidance.
Contact developer Qingyun_PengMinghang through https://mctier.pmhs.top or https://github.com/pmh1314520/MCTier for access, correction, deletion or privacy questions. Do not post passwords or cookies publicly. Both clients offer these documents offline; revised texts ship with app releases.

MCTier 用户协议
更新日期：2026年10月3日

一、同意与使用
首次使用须阅读隐私政策、用户协议、权限用途说明及免责声明，并点击“同意并继续”。不同意可退出；不会因仅下载软件而视为同意。功能授权、系统权限与可选夸克赞助均独立于本协议，不因同意本协议自动开通。

二、服务范围
MCTier 提供基于 EasyTier 的虚拟局域网、聊天室、语音消息与通话、文件和屏幕共享、远程控制、录屏、变声、弹幕和房间工具。不同设备、系统版本及网络条件的能力可能不同。应仅连接你信任的大厅和节点，妥善保管密码与设备权限。

三、行为规范
不得未经授权访问、控制或监控他人设备；不得传播恶意程序或违法、侵权内容；不得利用变声、聊天或远控进行诈骗、冒充、骚扰或盗取信息；不得干扰网络或从事未经许可的经营性接入、非法跨境联网等违法活动。你应对所传输、分享、录制和发布的内容及取得的授权负责。

四、共享、远控和录屏
远控必须由被控方明确接受，且可随时终止；系统可能另行要求屏幕捕获或无障碍授权。录屏与屏幕共享是不同功能，启动录屏需要你主动选择，涉及他人声音、画面或个人信息时须依法取得必要授权。保存后由你管理文件、备份和后续分享。软件不会保证受保护内容可被采集，也不应被用于绕过保护。

五、许可、第三方与变更
MCTier 自有代码按随附 LICENSE 授权，第三方组件各自的许可证不受本协议替代或限制。本项目非 Mojang/Microsoft 官方产品。夸克、节点及外部网站依各自规则服务，赞助为可选项，不承诺转存次数等同实际收益。
功能和协议可能随版本修订，可在设置随时查看。涉及依法需重新取得同意的处理，须另行征求同意。本协议不排除法律赋予你的权利或开发者依法应承担的义务。
documents.en:
MCTier User Agreement
Updated: 3 October 2026

1. Acceptance
Read the Privacy Policy, User Agreement, Permission Usage and Disclaimer, then select Agree & Continue on first use. You may exit if you disagree; downloading alone is not acceptance. Feature authorization, system permissions and optional Quark support remain separate choices.

2. Service
MCTier offers EasyTier virtual networking, chat, voice messages and calls, file and screen sharing, remote control, recording, voice changing, danmaku and room tools. Capabilities depend on device, system and network. Join trusted lobbies and nodes and protect passwords and permissions.

3. Conduct
Do not access, control or monitor devices without authorization, distribute malware or unlawful or infringing content, use voice changing or remote control for fraud, impersonation, harassment or theft, disrupt networks, or conduct unlawful networking or unlicensed commercial access operations. You are responsible for your content and required authorizations.

4. Sharing, remote control and recording
Remote control requires explicit acceptance by the controlled party, who may stop at any time; the OS may require capture or accessibility permission. Recording and screen sharing are separate features. Start recording intentionally and obtain any legally required consent for other people's voices, images and personal data. You manage saved files, backups and subsequent sharing. Protected content may be unavailable for capture; do not bypass its protection.

5. Licenses, third parties and changes
MCTier's own code follows the bundled LICENSE; third-party licenses remain independent. This is not an official Mojang or Microsoft product. Quark, nodes and external sites have their own terms. Support is optional; transfer counts do not guarantee income.
Features and terms may change with releases and remain available in settings. Any processing requiring renewed consent by law must obtain it separately. These terms do not remove your statutory rights or the developer's legal obligations.

documents.zh:
MCTier 权限用途说明
更新日期：2026年10月3日

共通用途
• 麦克风：语音通话、语音消息、变声试听及你开启的录屏麦克风。
• 屏幕采集：你启动的屏幕共享、远程被控或录屏；停止对应会话可终止采集。
• 文件与媒体：选择共享内容、读取聊天附件、保存下载、录音或录像；使用你选择或设置的目录。
• 网络：大厅与节点连接、信令、文件通信、版本检查，以及主动开启的第三方功能。

Android
• VPN：通过系统 VPN 接口建立游戏虚拟局域网。
• 相机：扫描大厅二维码。
• MediaProjection：通过系统授权采集整个屏幕或支持系统上的单应用；内部声音捕获受系统和被录应用限制。
• 无障碍：仅在接受远控会话后执行授权的点击、滑动等操作，可在系统设置关闭。
• 悬浮窗：弹幕与游戏 HUD；通知和前台服务：语音、共享、录屏等进行中的状态与操作。
• 安装未知应用：手动安装应用更新；电池优化豁免：按需减少后台连接被挂起，不保证后台永不停止。
• 文件夹授权与媒体库：访问选定文件夹或保存录像，不等于授权读取设备全部文件。

桌面端
• 系统麦克风与屏幕捕获：通过系统音频/图形接口完成选定采集。
• 虚拟网卡、防火墙和管理员操作：按需配置组网，部分操作须系统提权。
• 系统凭据存储：保护登录凭据；任务计划程序：夸克登录后执行后台每日检查，退出登录时注销。
• 开机启动、全局快捷键、托盘与文件夹选择：按你的设置启用。

可在应用或系统设置关闭相应功能和权限；拒绝某项权限只影响依赖该权限的功能。系统展示的具体权限名称以当前版本为准。
documents.en:
MCTier Permission Usage
Updated: 3 October 2026

Common purposes
• Microphone: calls, voice messages, voice auditions and recording when you enable microphone audio.
• Screen capture: screen sharing, accepted remote control and recordings you start; ending the session stops its capture.
• Files and media: selected shares, chat attachments, downloads, audio and video saved to selected or configured folders.
• Network: lobbies, nodes, signaling, file transfer, update checks and optional third-party features.

Android
• VPN: a virtual LAN for games through the system VPN interface.
• Camera: scanning lobby QR codes.
• MediaProjection: system-authorized full-screen or supported single-app capture; device audio depends on OS and captured-app restrictions.
• Accessibility: authorized taps and swipes during an accepted remote session; disable through system settings.
• Overlay: danmaku and game HUD; notifications and foreground services: ongoing voice, sharing and recording status and controls.
• Install unknown apps: manual app updates; battery optimization exemption: reduce background suspension when requested, without guaranteeing uninterrupted execution.
• Folder grants and media library: selected folders and saved recordings, not unrestricted access to all files.

Desktop
• System audio and graphics capture: selected microphone and screen sources.
• Virtual adapter, firewall and administrator operations: networking setup, sometimes requiring OS elevation.
• System credential storage protects logins; Task Scheduler runs Quark daily checks after login and unregisters on sign-out.
• Startup, global shortcuts, tray and folder selection follow your settings.

Disable features or revoke permissions in app or system settings. Refusal affects only dependent features. Exact permission names depend on the installed system.

MCTier 免责声明
更新日期：2026年10月3日

MCTier 是供合法联机与协作使用的工具。你应确认对设备、网络、共享文件、声音和画面具有必要权利和授权，并遵守所在地法律。不得用于未经同意的监控、侵入、诈骗、侵权或其他违法活动。

网络、中继、第三方服务、硬件驱动、系统权限和后台调度会影响连接、音频、视频、文件保存及自动任务。软件无法保证在所有设备上持续可用或无错误；重要文件应自行备份，录制完成后应检查文件。夸克转存成功不等同平台确认计佣，参考金额不是收益承诺。

开发者不控制用户之间的具体通信内容，也无法保证接收方不会截取、保存或再次转发。主动上传反馈或访问外部网站前应检查内容和目标。使用不受信任的节点或允许他人远控可能暴露屏幕、网络服务或个人信息。

软件按现状提供，责任限制仅在适用法律允许的范围内生效。本声明不免除开发者依法不得免除的责任，不排除用户法定权利，也不改变第三方开源许可证所赋予的权利。发现漏洞或隐私问题可通过官网或项目仓库反馈，请勿公开披露他人秘密或登录凭证。
documents.en:
MCTier Disclaimer
Updated: 3 October 2026

MCTier is a tool for lawful networking and collaboration. Confirm that you have the required rights and authorization for devices, networks, files, audio and images, and comply with local law. Unauthorized surveillance, intrusion, fraud, infringement and other unlawful uses are prohibited.

Networks, relays, third-party services, drivers, OS permissions and background scheduling affect connections, audio, video, file saving and automatic tasks. Availability and error-free operation cannot be guaranteed on every device. Back up important data and check completed recordings. Successful Quark transfers do not establish commission eligibility; reference amounts are not income promises.

The developer does not control communications between users and cannot ensure recipients will not capture, save or forward content. Review feedback and external destinations before submitting data. Untrusted nodes and remote access can expose screens, network services or personal information.

The software is provided as is, with liability limitations only where permitted by applicable law. This disclaimer does not waive non-excludable liability, statutory user rights or rights under third-party open-source licenses. Report vulnerabilities or privacy issues through the website or repository without publicly exposing secrets or credentials.
